reviewer: F independent Codex model review; not a human linguist certification
method: Purposive stratified inspection of N1/N2/N3/N4 grammar connection/negation/register, each corresponding Japanese example, all relation groups and 8 varied scenario prompts. F read and judged actual source/translation pairs separately from C provider review. No external translation model calls were made.
scope: 62 of 546 artifact records; not statistical or exhaustive linguistic certification

records.title: ～べく

source.explanation: 为了……；以便……。是「～ために」的正式书面表达。
source.connectionRule: 动词辞书形＋べく；する→すべく／するべく

english.explanation: In order to...; so that.... A formal written expression of 「～ために」.
english.connectionRule: Dictionary form verb + べく; する→すべく／するべく

records.reviewNote: Purpose and formal written register retained; すべく example aligns.

records.japanese: 問題を解決すべく、専門家による調査が始まった。
records.chinese: 为了解决问题，专家开始了调查。
records.english: In order to solve the problem, an investigation by experts began.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～が早いか

source.explanation: 刚一……就……；前项刚发生，后项几乎同时发生。
source.connectionRule: 动词辞书形＋が早いか

english.explanation: As soon as...; the moment the first action occurred, the second occurred almost simultaneously.
english.connectionRule: Dictionary form verb + が早いか

records.reviewNote: Near-simultaneous sequence preserved; example is an observed past event.

records.japanese: ベルが鳴るが早いか、学生たちは教室を飛び出した。
records.chinese: 铃声刚响，学生们就冲出了教室。
records.english: As soon as the bell rang, the students rushed out of the classroom.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～がてら

source.explanation: 顺便……；在做主要事情的同时顺便做另一件事。
source.connectionRule: 动词ます形（去ます）／动作性名词＋がてら

english.explanation: While...; on the occasion of...; do one thing while doing another as one's main activity.
english.connectionRule: Verb masu-stem (drop ます) / action noun + がてら

records.reviewNote: Main activity versus incidental stop is preserved in the example and main-activity explanation.

records.japanese: 散歩がてら、コンビニへ行ってきます。
records.chinese: 我去散步，顺便去一趟便利店。
records.english: I'm going for a walk, and I'll stop by the convenience store on the way.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～かたがた

source.explanation: 兼……；顺便……。常用于拜访、问候等正式场合。
source.connectionRule: 动作性名词＋かたがた

english.explanation: Serving as both...; while also.... Often used for formal occasions such as visits and greetings.
english.connectionRule: Action noun + かたがた

records.reviewNote: Dual-purpose formal visit/greeting retained; polite Japanese reference not rewritten.

records.japanese: 帰国のご報告かたがた、ご挨拶に伺いました。
records.chinese: 我来向您问候，也顺便报告回国的事情。
records.english: I came to greet you and also to report my return to my home country.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～ないまでも

source.explanation: 即使达不到……的程度，至少也……。
source.connectionRule: 动词ない形（去掉ない）＋ないまでも

english.explanation: Even if not to the extent of..., at least...
english.connectionRule: Verb ない-form (drop ない) + ないまでも

records.reviewNote: Not full extent but minimum fallback preserved; no negation inversion.

records.japanese: 毎日とは言わないまでも、週に一度は運動したい。
records.chinese: 即使不能每天运动，至少也想每周运动一次。
records.english: Even if not every day, I want to exercise at least once a week.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～をものともせず（に）

source.explanation: 不把……当回事；不顾……而勇敢行动。通常含有赞赏的语气。
source.connectionRule: 名词＋をものともせず（に）

english.explanation: Not letting... bother one; acting bravely without regard for... Usually carries a tone of praise.
english.connectionRule: Noun + をものともせず（に）

records.reviewNote: Action despite opposition and approving register are explicitly retained.

records.japanese: 彼は周囲の反対をものともせず、計画を実行した。
records.chinese: 他不顾周围人的反对，执行了计划。
records.english: He carried out the plan, disregarding the opposition of those around him.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～上で（目的）

source.explanation: 在做……时；在……方面。后项表示需要注意的重要事项。
source.connectionRule: 动词辞书形＋上で；名词＋の＋上で

english.explanation: When doing...; in terms of.... The second clause states an important point requiring attention.
english.connectionRule: Verb dictionary form + 上で; Noun + の + 上で

records.reviewNote: Dictionary-form purpose/context reading correctly distinguished from ta-form sequence reading.

records.japanese: 外国で生活する上で、言葉はとても重要だ。
records.chinese: 在国外生活时，语言非常重要。
records.english: When living abroad, language is very important.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～に際して

source.explanation: 在……之际；当……的时候。用于特别或正式的场合。
source.connectionRule: 名词＋に際して；动词辞书形＋に際して

english.explanation: On the occasion of...; when.... Used for special or formal situations.
english.connectionRule: Noun + に際して; Verb dictionary form + に際して

records.reviewNote: Special/formal occasion and request retained.

records.japanese: 入学に際して、必要な書類を提出してください。
records.chinese: 入学时请提交必要的材料。
records.english: When enrolling, please submit the necessary documents.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～次第

source.explanation: 一……就立即……。后项常表示有意识的行动。
source.connectionRule: 动词ます形（去掉ます）＋次第；名词＋次第

english.explanation: As soon as...; immediately.... The second clause often expresses a deliberate action.
english.connectionRule: verb masu-form (drop masu) + 次第; noun + 次第

records.reviewNote: Masu-stem and prompt intentional next action retained; example uses でき次第.

records.japanese: 準備ができ次第、出発します。
records.chinese: 准备好以后马上出发。
records.english: As soon as preparations are ready, we will depart.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～上で（先后）

source.explanation: 在做了……之后，再……。
source.connectionRule: 动词た形＋上で；名词＋の＋上で

english.explanation: After doing..., then....
english.connectionRule: verb ta-form + 上で; noun + の + 上で

records.reviewNote: Ta-form prior completed action preserved and distinguished from purpose sense.

records.japanese: 家族と相談した上で、返事をします。
records.chinese: 和家人商量之后再答复。
records.english: I will reply after discussing it with my family.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～限りでは

source.explanation: 据……所知；在……的范围内判断。
source.connectionRule: 动词辞书形／た形＋限りでは；名词＋の＋限りでは

english.explanation: As far as... know; judging within the range of....
english.connectionRule: Verb dictionary form / ta-form + 限りでは; Noun + の + 限りでは

records.reviewNote: Evidence-limited claim and negative result preserved; English is slightly literal but clear.

records.japanese: 私が調べた限りでは、問題は見つからなかった。
records.chinese: 据我调查，没有发现问题。
records.english: As far as I investigated, no problems were found.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～ようか～まいか

source.explanation: 是要……还是不要……；在两种选择之间犹豫。
source.connectionRule: 动词意志形＋か＋动词辞书形＋まいか；Ⅰ类动词（五段动词）词尾「あ段」＋まい；Ⅱ类动词（一段动词）去掉「る」＋まい；する→すまい／するまい；くる→こまい／くるまい

english.explanation: Whether to... or not...; hesitating between two choices.
english.connectionRule: Verb volitional form + か + verb dictionary form + まいか; Group I verbs (godan verbs) stem ending in the "a" row + まい; Group II verbs (ichidan verbs) drop る + まい; する→すまい／するまい; くる→こまい／くるまい

records.reviewNote: F-L01: source and English incorrectly teach godan a-row + まい. Correct godan nonpast/dictionary form.

records.japanese: 転職しようかするまいか、迷っている。
records.chinese: 我正在犹豫要不要换工作。
records.english: I am wondering whether or not to change jobs.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～てからでないと・～てからでなければ

source.explanation: 如果不先……就不能……。
source.connectionRule: 动词て形＋からでないと；动词て形＋からでなければ

english.explanation: If you don't first..., you can't...
english.connectionRule: verb te-form + からでないと; verb te-form + からでなければ

records.reviewNote: Negative prerequisite correctly retained; actual item must be seen before a decision.

records.japanese: 実物を見てからでないと、買うかどうか決められない。
records.chinese: 如果不先看到实物，就无法决定是否购买。
records.english: Unless you see the actual item first, you can't decide whether to buy it.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～にしても～にしても

source.explanation: 无论……还是……；列举两种情况，结论相同。
source.connectionRule: 动词た形＋にしても；イ形容词＋にしても；ナ形容词＋にしても；名词＋にしても

english.explanation: Whether... or...; listing two cases with the same conclusion.
english.connectionRule: ta-form of verb + にしても; i-adjective + にしても; na-adjective + にしても; noun + にしても

records.reviewNote: F-L02: only ta-form listed, contradicting this entry own 行く/行かない example. Teach plain forms.

records.japanese: 行くにしても行かないにしても、早く決めてください。
records.chinese: 无论去还是不去，请尽快决定。
records.english: Whether you go or not, please decide quickly.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～わけにはいかない

source.explanation: 不能……；由于社会常识、责任或心理原因无法做。
source.connectionRule: 动词辞书形＋わけにはいかない；动词ない形＋わけにはいかない

english.explanation: Cannot...; unable to do due to social norms, responsibility, or psychological reasons.
english.connectionRule: Verb dictionary form + わけにはいかない; verb nai-form + わけにはいかない

records.reviewNote: F-L04: nai-form listed under a cannot-do-only gloss, without explaining that it reverses obligation.

records.japanese: 明日は試験なので、遊んでいるわけにはいかない。
records.chinese: 明天有考试，所以不能一直玩。
records.english: I have an exam tomorrow, so I can't just keep playing.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～ないわけにはいかない

source.explanation: 不能不……；由于责任或情况必须做。
source.connectionRule: 动词ない形＋わけにはいかない

english.explanation: Cannot not...; must do due to responsibility or circumstances.
english.connectionRule: Verb nai-form + わけにはいかない

records.reviewNote: Double-negative obligation explanation correctly means must do; paired example is separately failed.

records.japanese: 上司に頼まれたので、断らないわけにはいかない。
records.chinese: 上司拜托了，所以不能拒绝。
records.english: My boss asked me, so I can't refuse.
records.reviewNote: F-L03: 断らないわけにはいかない means must refuse, but both translations say cannot refuse. Polarity is reversed; source context also incoherent.

records.title: ～わけだ

source.explanation: 难怪……；也就是说……；理所当然会得出这一结论。
source.connectionRule: 动词普通形＋わけだ；イ形容词普通形＋わけだ；ナ形容词词干＋な＋わけだ；名词＋の＋わけだ

english.explanation: No wonder...; that is to say...; it naturally follows that....
english.connectionRule: Verb plain form + わけだ; i-adjective plain form + わけだ; na-adjective stem + な + わけだ; Noun + の + わけだ

records.reviewNote: Inference/no-wonder reading and na-adjective な connection retained.

records.japanese: 彼は日本に十年住んでいる。日本語が上手なわけだ。
records.chinese: 他在日本住了十年，难怪日语说得好。
records.english: He has lived in Japan for ten years. No wonder his Japanese is good.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～わけ（が）ない

source.explanation: 绝不可能……。表示说话人强烈否定。
source.connectionRule: 动词普通形＋わけがない；イ形容词普通形＋わけがない；ナ形容词词干＋な＋わけがない；名词＋の＋わけがない

english.explanation: Absolutely impossible that.... Expresses the speaker's strong denial.
english.connectionRule: Verb plain form + わけがない; i-adjective plain form + わけがない; na-adjective stem + な + わけがない; Noun + の + わけがない

records.reviewNote: Strong impossibility preserved; cannot finish in one day is not merely uncertainty.

records.japanese: 一日でこの仕事が終わるわけがない。
records.chinese: 这项工作不可能一天完成。
records.english: There's no way this work will be finished in one day.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～とは限らない

source.explanation: 不一定……；不能断定全部情况都如此。
source.connectionRule: 动词普通形＋とは限らない；イ形容词普通形＋とは限らない；ナ形容词词干＋だとは限らない；名词＋だとは限らない

english.explanation: Not necessarily...; you cannot conclude that all cases are so.
english.connectionRule: verb plain form + とは限らない; i-adjective plain form + とは限らない; na-adjective stem + だとは限らない; noun + だとは限らない

records.reviewNote: Not necessarily/all-cases qualification preserved; not translated as absolute negation.

records.japanese: 高いものが必ずしも良いとは限らない。
records.chinese: 贵的东西不一定就好。
records.english: Expensive things are not necessarily good.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: ～わけではない

source.explanation: 并不是……；并非所有情况都如此。
source.connectionRule: 动词普通形＋わけではない；イ形容词普通形＋わけではない；ナ形容词词干＋な＋わけではない；名词＋の＋わけではない

english.explanation: It is not that...; it is not the case that all situations are so.
english.connectionRule: verb plain form + わけではない; i-adjective plain form + わけではない; na-adjective stem + な + わけではない; noun + の + わけではない

records.reviewNote: Partial negation preserved; dislike is not asserted.

records.japanese: 甘いものが嫌いなわけではない。
records.chinese: 我并不是讨厌甜食。
records.english: It's not that I dislike sweet things.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: NはNではありません

source.explanation: A不是B。「ではありません」是「です」的礼貌否定形式。
source.connectionRule: 名词＋は＋名词＋ではありません

english.explanation: A is not B. "ではありません" is the polite negative form of "です".
english.connectionRule: Noun + は + Noun + ではありません

records.reviewNote: Polite copular negation and non-student proposition retained.

records.japanese: 田中さんは学生ではありません。
records.chinese: 田中先生不是学生。
records.english: Tanaka-san is not a student.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: N［場所］にN［无生命］があります

source.explanation: 某地有某个无生命物体或植物。「に」表示存在地点。
source.connectionRule: 名词［场所］＋に＋名词［无生命］＋があります

english.explanation: There is an inanimate object or plant in a certain place. 「に」 marks the place of existence.
english.connectionRule: Noun [place] + に + Noun [inanimate] + があります

records.reviewNote: Inanimate object existence and location に retained; book/desk reference matches.

records.japanese: 机の上に本があります。
records.chinese: 桌子上有一本书。
records.english: There is a book on the desk.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: N［場所］にN［有生命］がいます

source.explanation: 某地有某个人或动物。
source.connectionRule: 名词［场所］＋に＋名词［有生命］＋がいます

english.explanation: There is a certain person or animal in a certain place.
english.connectionRule: Noun [place] + に + Noun [animate] + がいます

records.reviewNote: Person/animal existence and location retained; plural children acceptable from Japanese number-neutral source.

records.japanese: 公園に子どもがいます。
records.chinese: 公园里有孩子。
records.english: There are children in the park.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

records.title: 疑問詞＋も＋動詞（否定）

source.explanation: 表示全面否定，如「何も」什么都不、「誰も」谁都不。
source.connectionRule: 疑问词＋も＋动词（否定形）

english.explanation: Expresses complete negation, e.g. 「何も」 nothing at all, 「誰も」 no one at all.
english.connectionRule: Question word + も + Verb (negative form)

records.reviewNote: Interrogative + も with negative predicate retains exhaustive no-one scope.

records.japanese: 部屋には誰もいません。
records.chinese: 房间里一个人也没有。
records.english: There is no one in the room.
records.reviewNote: Independently compared Japanese proposition, negation, temporal relationship and referents with Chinese and English; no material discrepancy found.

source.title: ～が早いか／～や否や／～なり
source.notes: 共同点：都表示“一……就……”，强调前后动作相隔时间很短。

english.title: ～が早いか／～や否や／～なり
english.notes: Common point: all mean "as soon as...", emphasizing that very little time passes between the two actions.

records.reviewNote: Near-immediate sequence retained for three forms.

source.title: ～そばから
source.notes: 重点：刚做完又出现相同情况，常表示反复发生，并带有无奈感。

english.title: ～そばから
english.notes: Key point: just after doing something, the same situation occurs again; often expresses repetition and carries a sense of helplessness.

records.reviewNote: Repetition plus helplessness preserved, not merely a one-time temporal event.

source.title: ～がてら／～かたわら／～かたがた
source.notes:
～がてら：做A的时候顺便做B。
～かたわら：长期同时从事两项活动。
～かたがた：正式场合中的“兼、顺便”，常用于拜访和问候。

english.title: ～がてら／～かたわら／～かたがた
english.notes:
～がてら: do B while doing A.
～かたわら: engage in two activities at the same time over the long term.
～かたがた: "also serving as, while also" in formal situations, often used for visits and greetings.

records.reviewNote: ADVISORY: do B while doing A omits explicit incidental/opportunity nuance for がてら, blurring comparison with long-term かたわら; add take the opportunity to.

source.title: ～をものともせず／～をよそに
source.notes:
～をものともせず：不顾困难采取行动，一般带有赞赏语气。
～をよそに：无视他人的担心或反对，一般带有批评语气。

english.title: ～をものともせず／～をよそに
english.notes:
～をものともせず: act without regard for difficulties, generally with a tone of praise.
～をよそに: ignore others' worries or opposition, generally with a tone of criticism.

records.reviewNote: Praise versus criticism distinction preserved for ものともせず / よそに.

source.title: ～に即して／～を踏まえて
source.notes:
～に即して：按照规则、事实或现实情况来处理。
～を踏まえて：把已有的经验、结果或意见作为判断基础。

english.title: ～に即して／～を踏まえて
english.notes:
～に即して: handle according to rules, facts, or the actual situation.
～を踏まえて: use existing experience, results, or opinions as the basis for judgment.

records.reviewNote: Acting in accordance with a standard versus evidence as a judgment basis preserved.

source.title: 三种「いかん」
source.notes:
～いかんで：结果取决于……
～いかんでは：根据情况，可能会……
～いかんにかかわらず：无论……如何，都……

english.title: Three kinds of 「いかん」
english.notes:
～いかんで: the result depends on...
～いかんでは: depending on the situation, it may...
～いかんにかかわらず: regardless of how..., ...

records.reviewNote: Depends on / may depending on / regardless of contrast preserved.

source.promptZh: 用正式书面表达回应一种反对意见，承认其合理之处并提出你的判断。

english.prompt: Respond to an objection in formal written expression, acknowledge its valid points, and state your judgment.

records.reviewNote: Objective, polarity/qualification, interlocutor and requested register preserved; no instruction to answer in a non-Japanese language introduced.

source.promptZh: 朋友询问活动预算，请说明你最多能承担的大致金额。

english.prompt: A friend asks about the event budget; explain roughly the maximum amount you can cover.

records.reviewNote: Objective, polarity/qualification, interlocutor and requested register preserved; no instruction to answer in a non-Japanese language introduced.

source.promptZh: 告诉朋友你学习时刚记住内容就又忘记的烦恼，突出反复发生。
